title: lolium × subnutans
intro: Lolium × subnutans, commonly known as a hybrid grass species, is a cross between Lolium perenne and Lolium multiflorum. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to help in the treatment of digestive issues and its potential anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Lolium × subnutans include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include various flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its potential health benefits.
